Court Rules

Four pickleball courts share one reserved tennis court.

Social 1
Social 2
Social 3
Challenge

Social Courts

All skill levels are welcome. When players are waiting, all four players rotate off after the game and the next four paddles go on.

Challenge Court

Winners stay when there’s a queue. The other team rotates off and the next two paddles go on.

All Courts

Place your paddle in the queue for the court you want. Play doubles to 11, win by 2. Rotate promptly when your game ends.
